sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: Instead of staying bitter, I decided to take everything I learned, fix every architectural limitation of the old approach, and build a completely open, horizontal System 1 decision model family: Laya.

sources.title: laya · PyPI
sources.snippet: omp-laya-judge: an oh-my-pi plugin with a local System-1 judge MCP server and skill (choice / bool / score, 0 tokens, about 0.3 s on CPU), confidence-gated escalation, and reproducible quiz and Snake demos.

sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: From our March 2025 arXiv paper on sequence conversion trajectories to Laya: a sub-35ms open-weight System 1 decision engine with RLCD, multilingual routing across 100+ languages, and state-of-the-art calibration.
